observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow/orange gas cylinder with a sticker showing partial text and a red drum icon; valve area shows some rust spots.
Photo 1 shows a different blue gas cylinder with a visible brand logo reading 'BERADISCO' near the base of the neck.
Photo 2 shows the same blue cylinder from a different angle, close-up of the valve and collar; collar shows rust/wear at the weld seam.
No kg capacity markings, manufacture date, or test/inspection stamp are legible in any photo.
The listing text claims a single '12.5kg standard Cooking Gas Cylinder' but two visually distinct cylinders (different colors, different brand) appear in the photo set.

identity.kind: 12.5kg LPG cooking gas cylinder (two different cylinders shown)

claims.evidence: No kg marking or capacity stamp is legible on either cylinder in any photo.
Photo 0 shows a yellow cylinder, photos 1-2 show a different blue BERADISCO cylinder; these cannot be the same single unit.

risks.risk: Which cylinder (yellow or blue) is actually being sold is unclear, so the buyer could receive an unexpected item.
risks.proof: A single clear photo set of only the actual item for sale, with the seller confirming which one.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value/less certain of the two shown, i.e. as an unbranded, unverified-capacity cylinder

risks.risk: No visible capacity stamp (12.5kg) or manufacture/inspection date, so actual size and safety certification cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped capacity, serial number, and last test/inspection date on the cylinder shoulder.

risks.risk: Valve and collar show rust/wear (seen in photo 0 and photo 2), which could indicate leaks or a failed pressure test.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve threads and a demonstration/video of the valve holding pressure or a recent test certificate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a cylinder with a potentially faulty valve, i.e. not working condition

risks.risk: Cylinder could be sold empty (no gas), but 'cooking gas cylinder' listings sometimes imply gas included.
risks.proof: A weighing scale photo/video showing gross weight versus the tare weight stamped on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: priced as empty cylinder only, no gas included

proof_requests: A clear photo confirming exactly which single cylinder (yellow or blue BERADISCO) is for sale.
Close-up of the capacity stamp (kg), serial number, and manufacture/last inspection date on the cylinder neck/shoulder.
Close-up or video of the valve area showing no leaks, plus any recent test/safety certificate.
A weighing scale shot showing current gross weight to confirm tare vs filled state.
response.reason: The photos show two different, inconsistent cylinders under one listing claiming a single 12.5kg unit, and no capacity or safety markings are legible, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a specific verified item without clarification.
